scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=p.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(f);else if(e.name.endsWith('.css')){const rel=p.relative('src',f);fs.mkdirSync(p.dirname(p.join('dist',rel)),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(f,p.join('dist',rel))}}};walk('src')"
